messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

We're a small nonprofit organization ([URL_001]) launching a YouTube channel, and we need a thumbnail for our first video. Ideally, we would like it ready by the start of next week, on monday or tuesday. If you're able to help, I can send you the video, a google doc containing thumbnail ideas and guidance, and a thumbnail I attempted to make myself. We would prefer that the thumbnail contain no AI assets, though minor AI-assisted edits such as generative fill in photoshop are probably okay. Would you be able to help?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], I believe I can help with this.
We can discuss it further whenever you're available.

Please share the information about your channel and content, along with the previous thumbnail you made yourself.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
My thumbnail ideas are in this document: [URL_002]

You can view the current version of the video here: [URL_003]

I've also attached the thumbnail I made, although I think it's only okay.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: yes, there is room to improve things, and I can have the thumbnail completed within 24-48hrs. does that sound good?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: could you also send any competitor examples or designs you like? If there are brand guidelines you'd like me to follow, please share those too.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: please also send the title you currently have in mind for the video. Alongside your title, I can provide my own title Variations so that we can A/B Test them as well.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I have one question: I don't mind working on Hourly, but Sometimes watching the clock while working makes it difficult to concentrate. If you're comfortable with it, would you mind switching to a milestone-based arrangement?

share your thougths so we can begin working on it asap.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Okay I modified the offer!

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
> Can you also send any competitors or designs you like, as well as any brand guidelines you want me to follow?

Would it work for you if I keep all of my thoughts in the google doc here?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I'll Quickly review it now, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I believe I now have all the necessary details about the video, your ideas and thoughts, and the examples.

One final question: should I Extract an image of you directly from the video, or do you have any headshot pictures available?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
> Please send the video title you have in mind. I can also provide my own title Variations alongside yours so we can A/B Test them.

Our plan is to A/B test these three titles:

How we traced a bot-run newsroom back to OpenAI’s super PAC.
We caught OpenAI’s super PAC funding a bot-run newsroom.
The news site using AI bots as reporters.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yeah, if that's okay, I would prefer that you take my image directly from the video!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
we can use an image from the video, although I generally prefer separately taken photos because they have better Quality and give us more poses and images to work with.

However, if separate photos aren't possible, I Can pull images from the video, and we can replace them if you don't like the result.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Okay, great—thank you! For future videos, we could potentially take more headshot-style photos

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: for this one, though, using screenshots taken from the video should be fine

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
I also want to mention that although I don't use Ai for asset creation, I may use Generative Ai or other Ai's to generate certain elements or modify things in photos. I always make sure the result looks natural rather than looking like it was made by Ai.

I wanted to be transparent with you about the ways I use Ai.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Sure

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
> possibly generate certain elements or alter parts of photos with Generative Ai or other Ai's while ensuring everything still looks natural

I would prefer that you avoid doing any of that

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Regarding AI editing, I think we're only comfortable with limited uses such as photoshop's generative fill being used to remove a distracting prop in the background

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: However, we would prefer that no new assets be generated and that the photograph not be edited wholesale

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Could I show you before/after examples of some images to help give you confidence in the process?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: if you don't want that, then we won't do it

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yeah, I'm fine with you sharing examples, and I'm interested in how you're doing it. If your process involves uploading images to ChatGPT/Gemini/Midjourney/etc. and asking the tool to make changes, we would probably want to veto that

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Sorry about that—we're an AI industry watchdog group, and many of our supporters are concerned about issues such as AI's impact on artists. Because of that, we try not to use AI-generated assets or AI tools that perform coarse edits across an entire photo

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: first thing first, I Will not use Ai. I'll make sure all assets are original and are taken or created in photoshop.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yeah, unfortunately, I think these examples involve the AI generating content wholesale, even when it starts from existing photos. That's exactly the kind of thing we'd prefer to avoid. I hope that works for you!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Understood, [CLIENT_NAME_001]. I will not use AI to generate content wholesale, and every asset will be made manually in Photoshop. The sole AI use would be minimal Photoshop Generative Fill for minor touch-ups, never to create complete assets. Please let me know whether that works for you.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Great, that works. Thank you!

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Perfect—thank you, [CLIENT_NAME_001]! I'll begin working on it and deliver the thumbnail within 48hrs ... Sounds good

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hey [CLIENT_NAME_001], I hope you're doing well. Just a quick update:

The concept is fully finished, so all that remains is implementing everything. However, I've developed a fairly high fever and I'm being admitted for an IV drip. If I'm discharged today, I'll send the final thumbnail variation tonight; otherwise, I will definitely send it tomorrow.

After it's complete, please tell me if you'd like any revisions. I'm happy to continue refining it until you're completely satisfied with the result.

Best, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Hey [CLIENT_NAME_001], I hope you're well. I've created these two Concepts, and I also have a sillouhette version planned that I'll share shortly. In the meantime, please share your feedback on these, and I'm happy to help if any Revisions are Required.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

I haven't heard from you for a while regarding your feedback on the existing thumbnail design or any details for a new thumbnail, so I wanted to follow up in case you missed my earlier message.
I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Best,
[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
HI [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I'm very sorry for replying so late. Thank you for creating these! We ultimately chose a different thumbnail for the video, but I appreciate all your help. I'll make the payment now and include a bonus because the payment was delayed on our end.

Thank you again for all your help!

[CLIENT_NAME_001]
